level_one.title: Taskmaster
level_one.description: Every time Cho is hit by a Hero Basic Attack, reduce the cooldown of Shove by 1 second.

level_four.title: Rising Dread
level_four.description: Each bounce of Dread Orb increases its radius by 20% and damage by 15%. Activate Dread Orb before the second bounce ends to reverse the direction of the third bounce.

level_seven.title: Ogre Rampage
level_seven.description: Increase the damage bonus of Ogre Rage by 5%. Each time Gall damages an enemy Hero while Ogre Rage is active, this bonus increases by 1% for 4 seconds, up to an additional 10% bonus damage.

level_ten.title: Twisting Nether
level_ten.description: After 1 second, nearby enemies are Slowed by 50% while Gall channels, up to 5 seconds. Activate to deal 353 (+5% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Twilight Nova
level_thirteen.description: After the first bounce of Dread Orb, 2 extra bombs bounce to the sides once.

level_sixteen.title: Leaden Orb
level_sixteen.description: Dread Orb Stuns enemy Heroes for 0.6 seconds.

level_one.title: Contact Healing
level_one.description: Hitting Heroes with Biotic Grenade increases its damage and healing by 30% per Hero hit.

level_four.title: Biotic Enhancements
level_four.description: Increase the bonus healing duration of Biotic Grenade by 50% and reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Anti-Healer
level_seven.description: Increase the area of Biotic Grenade by 25% and the duration of the healing reduction by 0.75 seconds.

level_ten.title: Nano Boost
level_ten.description: Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.  Cannot be used on Ana.

level_thirteen.title: Purifying Darts
level_thirteen.description: Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.

level_sixteen.title: Active Reload
level_sixteen.description: Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.

level_one.title: Bird of Prey
level_one.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's damage by 150% to Minions.

level_four.title: Hungry Bear
level_four.description: Misha's Basic Attacks heal her for 4.5% of her maximum Health.

level_seven.title: Taking Flight
level_seven.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's range by 20%. If Spirit Swoop hits an enemy Hero, the Mana cost is refunded and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Bestial Wrath
level_ten.description: Increases Misha's Basic Attack damage by 200% for 12 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Aspect of the Hawk
level_thirteen.description: When Spirit Swoop hits an enemy Hero, Rexxar gains 125% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Misha's Basic Attacks increase the duration of this buff by 0.75 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Feign Death
level_sixteen.description: Rexxar fakes his death, becoming Invulnerable and untargetable for 5 seconds. During this time you control Misha.

level_one.title: Calloused Hide
level_one.description: While under 50% maximum Health, Cho gains 15% increased Movement Speed and healing received.

level_four.title: Uppercut
level_four.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Surging Fist deals additional damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their max Health and reduces the cooldown of Surging Fist by 5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Power Surge
level_seven.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Surging Fist are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Gain 15% Movement Speed while charging Surging Fist and for 2.5 seconds after casting the Ability.

level_ten.title: Upheaval
level_ten.description: After 1 second, pull enemies towards Cho'gall, Slowing them by 25% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 (+4% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Surging Dash
level_thirteen.description: While Channeling Surging Fist, Cho heals for 150 (+4% per level) Health per second.

level_sixteen.title: Runed Gauntlet
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Cho and Gall's Heroic Abilities by 6%.

level_one.title: Reinforced Carapace
level_one.description: Increase the Shield amount of Carapace by 40%.

level_four.title: Adrenal Overload
level_four.description: Heroic Symbiote hosts gain 25% increased Attack Speed.

level_seven.title: Calldown: MULE
level_seven.description: Activate to calldown a Mule that repairs Structures, one at a time, near target point for 40 seconds, healing for 90 Health every 1 second.

level_ten.title: Ultimate Evolution
level_ten.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

level_thirteen.title: Soma Transference
level_thirteen.description: Symbiote's Spike Burst heals the host for 64 (+4% per level) Health per enemy Hero hit.

level_sixteen.title: Adrenaline Boost
level_sixteen.description: Symbiote's Carapace increases the Movement Speed of the target by 40% for 3.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Viciousness
level_one.description: Increases Inner Beast's duration to 4 seconds, and causes Ability damage to also refresh its duration.

level_four.title: Thick Skin
level_four.description: Using Darkflight grants 50 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks while in Worgen Form, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

level_seven.title: Wizened Duelist
level_seven.description: Quest: Every 6 Human Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Basic Attack damage by 1%, up to 30%. Worgen Basic Attacks grant credit for 3 Basic Attacks. Half of this bonus is lost upon death.

level_ten.title: Cursed Bullet
level_ten.description: Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage.  Does not affect Vehicles.

level_thirteen.title: On the Prowl
level_thirteen.description: Inner Beast increases Movement Speed by 30% once it has been active for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Eager Wolf
level_sixteen.description: Increases the Attack Speed bonus of Inner Beast by an additional 40% after it has been active for 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Psi-Infusion
level_one.description: Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.  Passive: Increase the cast range of Psionic Storm by 33%.

level_four.title: Electric Fence
level_four.description: Force Wall deals 92 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

level_seven.title: Psionic Echo
level_seven.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

level_ten.title: Archon
level_ten.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.  Resonance Beam: Deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the target and splashes 70 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

level_thirteen.title: Feedback
level_thirteen.description: When an enemy Hero is affected by Psionic Storm, Resonance Beam's Slow is increased to 50% and it reduces Physical Armor by 25.

level_sixteen.title: Thermal Lance
level_sixteen.description: Shock Ray deals an additional 8% of maximum Health as damage to the first Hero it hits.

level_one.title: Pity the Frail
level_one.description: For every Hero hit with Searing Lash, lower the cooldown of Inquisition by 1 seconds. Allies below 30% Health receive 25% more healing from Whitemane.

level_four.title: Martyrdom
level_four.description: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

level_seven.title: Zealous Spirit
level_seven.description: Upon reaching 2 stacks of Desperation, Whitemane gains Zeal.

level_ten.title: Scarlet Aegis
level_ten.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 (+4% per level) and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Subjugation
level_thirteen.description: Inquisition reduces all damage the target deals by 50%.

level_sixteen.title: Shared Punishment
level_sixteen.description: Upon casting, Inquisition can chain to an additional enemy Hero near its target, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds. Affected enemies lose 10 Armor.

level_one.title: Laws of Hope
level_one.description: Activate to heal 20% of Johanna's max Health over 5 seconds.  Quest: Every 10 Regeneration Globes gathered increases this heal amount by 5% of Johanna's max Health.

level_four.title: Hold Your Ground
level_four.description: Increases Iron Skin's Shield by 40% and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

level_seven.title: Conviction
level_seven.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

level_ten.title: Blessed Shield
level_ten.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Blessed Hammer
level_thirteen.description: Activate to create 2 hammers that spiral outward from Johanna, dealing 65 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Damaging enemies with Basic Abilities reduce the cooldown of this Ability by 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Every 3rd Basic Attack against enemy Heroes releases a hammer.

level_sixteen.title: Shrinking Vacuum
level_sixteen.description: Condemn reduces enemy Heroes damage by 30% and Slows by 30% for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Ossein Renewal
level_one.description: Activate to heal Leoric for 30% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. Regeneration Globes lower the cooldown of this Ability by 20 seconds.

level_four.title: Paralyzing Rage
level_four.description: Increase the Slow of Skeletal Swing by 20%.

level_seven.title: Willing Vessel
level_seven.description: Increase the healing from Drain Hope to 25% of Leoric's maximum Health. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, Leoric instantly heals for an additional 5% of his maximum Health.

level_ten.title: Entomb
level_ten.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Spectral Leech
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage to the primary target damage equal 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health and heal Leoric for 200% of the bonus damage dealt.

level_sixteen.title: Mithril Mace
level_sixteen.description: Increase Leoric's Attack Speed by 20%.  Repeatable Quest: Nearby enemy Minion deaths grant 0.3% permanent Attack Speed, and Takedowns grant 3% permanent Attack Speed, up to 30%.
